title: Eyed Spawn Eggs
description: This pack gives all spawn eggs tiny eyes and refreshes certain textures.
body:
# Eyed Spawn Eggs

This resource pack focuses on improving the visual consistency and readability of Spawn Eggs. 

### What's Changed:
* **Enhanced Readability:** Every spawn egg now has clearly defined eyes, making it easier to distinguish mobs at a glance.
* **Pixel-Perfect Adjustments:** I've manually shifted and realigned pixels on many icons to ensure the "face" is visible and looks natural.
* **Custom Redesigns:** Some eggs have been almost entirely retextured to better match the mob's unique identity while staying true to the vanilla style.



![Eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b051b7c7661ff3318724a406b7923524380124b8.png)
